title: The Heart of Healthcare (Halle Tecco) — 'Shareholder Primacy Is Breaking Healthcare' with Eric Ries
summary: Halle Tecco — Rock Health co-founder and long-standing digital health investor — releases a 40-minute Eric episode framed around why healthcare companies drift from patient mission toward shareholder primacy, with Novo Nordisk's ownership structure as the counter-example.
blockquote: Healthcare companies are built to improve patients' lives. So why do so many prioritize shareholders over the people they're meant to serve?
